notes: Notes - a 'where I left off' card on your dashboard, checklists you can tick from the tile, and notes attached to an order, a shopping list, a run or a codex entry. Crafting shopping lists - a whole armour set totalled into one list, with counts per blueprint and what you already hold read from your Inventory. Gems are counted in gems now, not SCU. Fleet Ops gained 27 ships including the ARGO MOTH. Inventory takes finished items with their crafted bonuses. Hull C hauling knows which stops it can actually dock at.
